summary: Break-glass accounts can always sign in, and a mail sender change is proven before it switches.

fixes.title: Break-glass accounts can always sign in
fixes.text: A Conditional Access change that would stop a break-glass account from signing in is refused. Only the break-glass templates may include them, with a control they can meet: MFA or the FIDO strength. CA095 is unchanged.

fixes.title: Queued changes checked again
fixes.text: Changes the web app hands to the engine are checked again by the engine - who may make them and what they change - before they run.

fixes.title: A sender change proven first
fixes.text: The mail setup switches the sender only after Entra Policy Suite itself may send as the new mailbox. If anything fails, the old rights are put back.
